name: Telecom Deployment Verification
description: Confirm a telecom service is listening and answering the check the project defines after a deploy.

permissionsRequired.reason: Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
See which process is listening or failing.
Read logs for a process this run already started.
Run a command on a configured server alias.
Read the official page a search result named.

validation.rule: The listener and a protocol check were reported. Process start alone was not called a successful deploy.
